description: Generate an llms.txt file (llmstxt.org format) for a public website. Uses the site name, summary and pages you pass; anything missing is filled from the homepage and sitemap.xml. Returns the file text plus notes on how to improve it.

pages.description: Optional list of the most important page URLs. If omitted, sitemap.xml is used.

summary.description: One paragraph: what the site is, who it is for, what is most useful.

name: generate_llms_txt
title: Generate llms.txt
